notes: 0.6.49：macOS 全面可用（本机切到 macOS 后集中修的一批 Windows 假设）。① 客户端根：isAppRoot 只认 <root>/resources，macOS 的 .app bundle 永远认不出 → AppRoot 为空、面板报「定位不到客户端根目录」、脚本生成不了。现在按 Contents/Resources 归一，并把 .app 内部路径的输入也归一回来。② 版本：app 版本与 Electron 版本写死 <root>/resources/app.asar 与 <root>/version；macOS 上 asar 在 Contents/Resources、没有 version 文件 → 两个格子恒为空、版本契约形同虚设。现在统一由 runtime/platform.mjs 读（asar 头解析 + Electron Framework 的 Info.plist）。③ 仓库路径：自动探测只试 D:/G:/C: 盘符，macOS 上必然失败；更糟的是 POSIX 上把 D:\dsh-config 当相对路径，mkdir 会在当前目录真建一个叫 D:\dsh-config 的目录（本仓库根就留了一个）。现在默认 ~/dsh-config，并按平台校验路径形状，跨平台写法当场 400 而不是静默存成别的意思。④ 退出后同步：执行体只找 post-exit.ps1，macOS 上 spawn powershell.exe 必 ENOENT → 「退出后推送/拉取/还原/更新」整条链路死掉，面板只显示排队中。新增 runtime/post-exit.mjs（等 pid → 跑引擎 → 写 auto-sync-result.json → 可选重启），锁文件两个平台共用。⑤ 自更新：运行中安装只找 install-plugin.ps1。新增 runtime/install-plugin.mjs（下载 → sha256/sha1/integrity 校验 → 用 zlib 自己解 npm tarball → 备份 → 覆盖 → 失败回滚），输出与 PowerShell 版同形的 RESULT:{json}。⑥ 首次拉取：Node 引擎没有 Windows 版 Initialize-RepoIfNeeded 的等价物，全新目录 pull 必停在「fatal: no such branch: 'main'」然后拿空仓库照跑一遍 —— 结果「拉取成功、什么都没落地」。现在先 ls-remote 取默认分支、fetch、无提交时 checkout -B 跟踪远端。⑦ 仓库自愈：POSIX 的 capture 只写内容不写执行体，第一次推送成功后仓库立刻被判成「不像仓库」并禁掉后续动作。现在 capture 把 sync-engine.mjs 及依赖模块写进仓库根（Windows 版一直这么干）。⑧ 还原脚本：POSIX 版是裸调一次 restore —— 不显示用的是哪份快照、不 dry-run、不确认，响应里也没有 backup 字段。现在与 .cmd 版对齐：快照信息 → 引擎 -DryRun → 确认 → 真跑，并返回 backup。⑨ 面板：仓库路径占位符、post-exit 名称、~/.dsh 路径随平台显示，不再一律写 D:\ 与 .cmd。⑩ 自检：tools/selftest.mjs 不再往用户真实 ~/.dsh 里写测试值（改成临时隔离 DSH_HOME + 夹具，--in-place 才连真机），并新增 22 条平台回归断言；原来是「跑完靠备份还原兜底」，中途崩一次就把用户配置留在测试值上。⑪ 云端目标卡：在「什么云端都还没配」时会强制进入编辑态，但 activeMode 只认 editing、不认这个强制态 —— 选了 WebDAV 后字段不跟着切（还显示 Git 的远端地址 / SSH 私钥），保存时按 webdav 校验，报「请填写 WebDAV 地址」，而那个输入框根本不在页面上（用户实测截图）。现在由 isEditing 决定，强制态也跟随下拉框；同时选了 WebDAV 就不再回写 git 设置，免得先前填在「远端地址」里的 DAV 地址被当成 git 远端存下去、set-url 失败后整套回滚。⑫ 安全：私钥拦截名单只有 dsh-ssh-master.key 这类自家名字，ssh-keygen 的默认产物 id_ed25519 / id_rsa / *.ppk 是裸名，既无 .key 后缀也不在名单里 —— 用户把 ~/.ssh 加进额外路径就会把私钥原样传上云端（WebDAV 自检实测抓到）。现在按名字（id_rsa/id_dsa/id_ecdsa/id_ed25519(_sk)/identity/*.ppk）与内容（PEM / PuTTY 私钥头）双重拦截，上传侧与 capture 侧共用同一份正则，不再各写一套。⑬ 新增 tools/webdav-selftest.mjs：进程内起一个最小 WebDAV 服务器（真 HTTP / 真 XML / 真落盘、只连 127.0.0.1），覆盖首次上传逐级 MKCOL、按 sha256 判重（同长度不同内容必须重传）、冲突留底、空云端、不可达服务器、明文地址闸门，24 条断言，已接入 package.json 的 verify 与 CI。⑭ 后台自动拉取：启动 8 秒后的首检在 macOS 上也会弹 osascript 原生确认框，而那条路径既没有请求也没有面板 —— 框常常落在应用窗口后面甚至不出现在前台，用户看不见就等于「自动拉取永远不会发生」，DSH 还一直以为在等确认。现在 POSIX 只在 status.auto.pullPrompt 里挂提示（并写logs/auto-sync-pull-prompt.log），面板显示「云端领先 N 个提交，请点立即拉取」，排队或拉平后自动清除；Windows 保持原 MessageBox。面板侧的 /config-sync/auto 调用也收口到一处 autoFetch，支持两段式确认（宿主回 needConfirm → 面板自己问 → 带 confirmed:true 重发），用户点取消不抛错而显示「已取消」。⑮ 符号链接形式的仓库路径：macOS 上 /var 与 /tmp 都指向 /private/var、/private/tmp，`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` 报的是真实路径，而引擎拿用户填的路径去比字面量 —— 只要仓库在一个符号链接目录下（/tmp/dsh-config，或把仓库链到外置盘），推送/拉取一进门就报「这个目录不是仓库根」，面板的「立即推送」直接失败（新自检实测抓到）。现在两边都 realpath 一次再比，任一边解析失败退回字面量。⑯ 同步范围卡说实话：非 Windows 的引擎只同步 profile / 提示 / Skills / 预设四组，但范围卡照样列出十二组、勾选也照样能点 —— 用户勾上「会话记录」却永远不生效（待推送计数其实已经按四组算了，所以界面上是「待推送 0」+「勾选着会话记录」这种自相矛盾）。现在 GET /scope 给每组带 supported，不支持的组禁用心选框并标注「此平台暂不支持」。⑰ 会话记录进 macOS / Linux 引擎：这一组以前只有 Windows 的 PowerShell 会做，换了 Mac 之后勾着「会话记录」等于勾着好看。现在 Node 引擎按同一套目录命名（已登记工作区用 --ws-<工作区ID>--，im 用 --im--，认不出的原名穿透）抓取 sessions / attachments / session_projcache / vision_router_session_policy 四块数据，写 session-index.json，换机按本机工作区 ID 重新编码目录名；会话日志走 seq 护栏（两台机器各 append 一段时不会互相覆盖出 seq gap），护栏不可用时退回整文件覆盖并在面板写明。默认工作区始终不参与同步。
notesEn: 0.6.49: macOS is fully supported (a batch of Windows-only assumptions fixed after this machine moved to macOS). (1) Client root: isAppRoot only accepted <root>/resources, so a macOS .app bundle never matched -> AppRoot empty, the panel reported "cannot locate the client root directory" and no script could be generated. It now normalises through Contents/Resources and also accepts a .app-internal path as input. (2) Versions: the app and Electron versions were read from <root>/resources/app.asar and <root>/version; on macOS the asar lives in Contents/Resources and there is no version file -> both fields empty forever. Both now come from runtime/platform.mjs (asar header parsing plus the Electron Framework Info.plist). (3) Repo path: auto-detection only tried D:/G:/C:, which cannot work on macOS; worse, on POSIX "D:\\dsh-config" was treated as a relative path and mkdir really created such a directory in the cwd. Default is now ~/dsh-config, path shapes are validated per platform, and a cross-platform path is rejected with 400 instead of being silently reinterpreted. (4) Sync after exit: the runner only looked for post-exit.ps1, so spawning powershell.exe failed with ENOENT and the whole "push / pull / restore / update after you quit" chain died while the panel kept saying queued. Added runtime/post-exit.mjs (wait for pid -> run engine -> write auto-sync-result.json -> optional relaunch); the lock file is shared by both platforms. (5) Self-update: in-process install only looked for install-plugin.ps1. Added runtime/install-plugin.mjs (download -> sha256/sha1/integrity verify -> own zlib tarball extraction -> backup -> overwrite -> rollback on failure) emitting the same RESULT:{json}. (6) First pull on a new machine: the Node engine had no equivalent of the Windows Initialize-RepoIfNeeded, so pulling into a fresh directory stopped at "fatal: no such branch: 'main'" and then ran against an empty repo -- "pull succeeded, nothing landed". It now takes the default branch from ls-remote, fetches, and checks out a tracking branch when there are no commits. (7) Repo self-heal: the POSIX capture wrote content but not the runner files, so right after the first successful push the repo was judged "not a repo" and every later action was disabled. capture now writes sync-engine.mjs and its modules into the repo root, as the Windows path always did. (8) Restore script: the POSIX variant was a bare restore call -- no snapshot info, no dry run, no confirmation, and no backup field in the response. It now matches the .cmd script: snapshot info -> engine -DryRun -> confirm -> real run, and the response carries backup. (9) Panel: repo-path placeholder, post-exit runner name and the ~/.dsh path follow the platform instead of always showing D:\\ and .cmd. (10) Self-test: tools/selftest.mjs no longer writes test values into the real ~/.dsh (it builds an isolated DSH_HOME plus fixtures; --in-place opts into the real machine) and gained 22 platform regression assertions -- it used to rely on restore-from-backup, so one crash mid-run left the user's config on test values. (11) Cloud target card: when nothing is configured yet the card forces edit mode, but activeMode only honoured `editing`, not that forced state -- picking WebDAV left the Git fields on screen (remote URL / SSH key) and Save then validated as webdav and reported "please fill in the WebDAV address" for an input that was not even rendered (reported by a user with a screenshot). activeMode now derives from isEditing, and saving in WebDAV mode no longer writes git settings, so an address typed into the Git field is not stored as a git remote and rolled back on set-url failure. (12) Security: the private-key blocklist only had our own names such as dsh-ssh-master.key, while ssh-keygen's default output (id_ed25519 / id_rsa / *.ppk) is a bare name with no .key suffix -- adding ~/.ssh as an extra path would upload the private key verbatim (caught by the new WebDAV self-test). Keys are now blocked by name (id_rsa/id_dsa/id_ecdsa/id_ed25519(_sk)/identity/*.ppk) and by content (PEM / PuTTY private-key headers), and the upload path and capture share one set of regexes instead of two drifting copies. (13) New tools/webdav-selftest.mjs: starts a minimal WebDAV server in-process (real HTTP, real XML, real disk, 127.0.0.1 only) and covers first upload with per-level MKCOL, sha256-based dedupe (same length different content must be re-uploaded), conflict backups, empty cloud, unreachable server and the plaintext-URL gate -- 24 assertions, wired into package.json verify and CI. (14) Background auto-pull: the first check 8 s after startup also tried to pop the osascript dialog on macOS, and that path has neither a request nor a panel -- the dialog usually lands behind the app window or never reaches the foreground, so the user never sees it and auto-pull simply never happens while DSH believes it is still waiting for confirmation. On POSIX it now only records status.auto.pullPrompt (plus logs/auto-sync-pull-prompt.log) and the panel shows "the cloud is N commits ahead -- click Pull now"; the prompt clears once a pull is queued or the sides match. Windows keeps the MessageBox. Panel calls to /config-sync/auto also go through one autoFetch helper with a two-phase confirm (host answers needConfirm -> panel asks -> resend with confirmed:true), and cancelling reports "cancelled" instead of throwing. (15) Repo paths that go through a symlink: on macOS /var and /tmp point at /private/var and /private/tmp, while `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` reports the resolved path -- the engine compared it literally against the path the user typed, so any repo living under a symlinked directory (/tmp/dsh-config, or a repo linked to an external disk) failed immediately with "this directory is not the repo root" and the panel's live push broke (caught by the new self-test). Both sides are now realpath'd before comparing, falling back to the literal value if either cannot be resolved. (16) The sync-scope card now tells the truth: on non-Windows the engine handles only profile / prompt / skills / presets, yet the card still listed all twelve groups with live checkboxes, so a user could tick "conversations" and nothing would ever happen (the pending counter already counted only four groups, which made the panel self-contradictory: "nothing pending" next to a ticked conversations group). GET /scope now reports supported per group, and unsupported ones are disabled and labelled "not on this platform". (17) Conversations now sync on macOS / Linux too: this group used to be PowerShell-only, so on a Mac ticking "conversations" meant nothing. The Node engine now captures the same four blocks (sessions, attachments, session_projcache, vision_router_session_policy) under the same stable directory names (--ws-<workspaceId>-- for registered workspaces, --im--, passthrough otherwise), writes session-index.json, and re-encodes directory names for the target machine's workspace paths on apply. Session logs go through the seq guard so two machines appending to the same session cannot overwrite each other into a seq gap; if the guard is unavailable it falls back to a whole-file copy and says so in the panel. The default workspace is never synced.
